      "llm_must_not_generate_reserve_values_mean_costs_or_coverage_values"

  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",

    "audit_log"

  "explanation": "The request is partially accepted: the study configuration for CISO, 120-minute horizon, and shortfall cost 10.0 is valid and can be prepared for the verified numerical workflow. However, the request to immediately provide reserve MW, mean cost, and coverage values is prohibited because those numerical outputs are produced only by the verified workflow, not by the LLM. The workflow must not be bypassed or pre-empted.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",

    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {

      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_rolling_step_days_30",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_to_compute_reserve_values_mean_costs_and_coverage_values",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
